title: Launch Target Detection and Delivery
description: How Explorer context menus become app actions.
body: What a launch was asked to open, and how a second launch reaches the first. Explorer's context menu is the only caller that matters: Open with OpenKaava runs this binary with one path as its argument. A second launch must not become a second process. tauri-plugin-single-instance hands the new argv to the process already running and exits. The first launch has nobody to tell yet — Tauri does not replay events, and at setup time no window listens. The target is parked in LaunchState for take_launch_target to collect.
